definitions.gloss: spring cabbage (early-spring variety, softer and sweeter)
definitions.explanation: A type of cabbage harvested mainly in spring, with softer, lighter-colored leaves and a sweeter, milder taste than ordinary cabbage. Especially prized for raw use such as in salads.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring) + ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧ (cabbage). Marketed as a seasonal product in Japan from around March to May. Has a looser, rounder head than winter cabbage.
